name: Nagutte, Kowashite.
source:
Kizaki Mao is a boy who stutters and has been unable to make friends since he was a child due to his disability. Mifune Yuuto is Mao's only friend.

Yuuto is a firm and kind person who often takes care of the shy Mao, but after a certain incident, the relationship between the two changed into a twisted one.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7648]NovelGame[/url]]
